name: verdant-scepter-rests-removes-a-counter-buffs-two-slimes-and-draws
notes: Verdant Scepter's activated ability: [REST], remove a refinement counter (prereq: at least one), put a buff counter on each of up to two chosen Slime allies, then draw. The draw handler is queued dontSkipOnPass so choosing no Slimes still draws.

rulesClauses: [REST], Remove a refinement counter from CARDNAME: Put a buff counter on each of up to two Slime allies you control then draw a card.

engineBug.summary: Verdant Scepter's activated ability was not implemented.
